captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a dirt-jump bicycle front fork and steering assembly. It features a wide, thick, metallic grey crown holding two parallel, cylindrical black fork legs connected by a thin bottom brace. A vertical steerer tube extends upward from the crown through a black head tube, terminating in a black mid-rise stem. Straight, light grey handlebars with black cylindrical grips are clamped into the stem faceplate. The steering assembly (including the handlebars, stem, and fork legs) is designed to rotate relative to the central head tube around its longitudinal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dirt-jump bike front fork and steering assembly. The assembly should include a wide metallic crown, two parallel black cylindrical legs, a central head tube, a mid-rise stem, and straight handlebars with black grips. Ensure appropriate rotational articulation is defined around the steering column axis.
captions.factory: Construct the assembly by defining separate parts for the frame head tube, the fork assembly, and the handlebars. For the fork, model a rectangular box for the crown and attach two vertical cylinders as legs, plus a thin horizontal cylinder as a brace. For the steering column, model the steerer tube, head tube, and stem using cylinders and boxes. Create the handlebar as a long horizontal cylinder with two larger-diameter cylindrical grips at each end. Finally, define a revolute joint representing the steering axis between the head tube and the rotating fork/handlebar assembly.
